newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil gains on futures, buyers hold back.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil gains on futures, buyers hold back.

text.p: NWE gas oil gained on stronger futures on Thursday but feeble end user interest undermined heating oil cargo premiums, traders said.
Benchmark IPE futures for front month November finished up $1.75 at $219 after retracing earlier gains as Brent futures slid in line with U.S. NYMEX gasoline losses.
A cargo of FOD 40 heating oil for arrival by November 8 in Bordeaux was traded at Nov IPE +4.50, equivalent to Nov IPE +$2.50 into Le Havre, but it was a moment of action in an otherwise dull day.
"There's nothing much happening in the market. It's almost totally quiet," one trader said.

Poor German demand for heating oil due to adequate supply and mild autumn weather has punctured buying interest and sellers say they must look to the onset of colder winter temperatures before any recovery in values can take place.
Low sulphur diesel cargoes cif NWE for early November were assessed at Dec IPE +$21/25. On barges,
On barges, low sulphur diesel winter grade was around $23/24. Heating oil refinery grade was discussed unchanged at around Nov IPE +$0.75/1.50.
